The wrapper script and desktop entries contain no malicious code or suspicious network activity. The only valid vote (qwen) correctly identified it as safe. disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was triggered because deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash returned an 'inconclusive' verdict due to an LLMResponseError (empty response) when auditing horizon.desktop. Per the rules, this tool error carries no verdict signal and is treated as missing. The openrouter report is marked as advisory and does not count as a vote. coverage_issues: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash failed to evaluate horizon.desktop due to an LLM API error (empty response), causing the entire audit to be marked inconclusive.
learnings: The audit tool should implement automatic retries for transient LLM API errors (like empty responses) on individual files to prevent a single file failure from cascading into an inconclusive package verdict and triggering unnecessary escalation reviews.

While skipping binary files like SVGs is standard, the tool could optionally run a quick `file` command check to ensure they are not disguised executable scripts, adding a layer of defense against disguised payload attacks.
